confirmed_official_spec_rules: Merged PR is the default Event candidate (associated commits attach as evidence without spawning direct-commit Events).
Default-branch direct commit is a candidate ONLY when PR association lookup completed normally (COMPLETED) and observed NO_MATCH_OBSERVED.
UNKNOWN PR association is NEVER interpreted as NO_MATCH_OBSERVED (no PR); classification is held.
Issue/ticket links attach strictly as CONTEXT_ONLY and NEVER trigger automatic merging.
User manual merge is allowed ONLY within the same repository (and same workspace) and is aggregated/counted as a single USER_COMPOSITE (no member double counting).
USER_COMPOSITE nesting is strictly forbidden (neither an existing USER_COMPOSITE root nor an already-subsumed member may be merged into another USER_COMPOSITE).
Dissolving a USER_COMPOSITE restores its constituent members and marks dependent Claims as stale.
B-003 (post-success automatic change discovery and late source association recovery) is tagged POST_MVP.
Dataset remains DRAFT (never frozen as golden by agent) and assumes no OD-007 physical database tables.

matrix.observable_outcome: 1 merged PR with 2 associated commits emits 1 active merged-PR Event (spec_event_type/spec_lifecycle_status='UNCONFIRMED'); associated commits attach as evidence without spawning direct-commit Events.

Default-branch commit with pr_association_lookup_status='COMPLETED' and pr_association_status='NO_MATCH_OBSERVED' emits 1 active direct-commit Event (spec_event_type/spec_lifecycle_status='UNCONFIRMED').

Commit with pr_association_lookup_status='INCOMPLETE_OR_FAILED' and pr_association_status='UNKNOWN' is placed in held_items (interpreted_as_no_pr=false, spec_hold_status='UNCONFIRMED'), never treated as NO_MATCH_OBSERVED, and rejected with CANNOT_LINK if targeted for merge.

Unmerged commit on a non-default branch with COMPLETED lookup + NO_MATCH_OBSERVED does NOT become a direct-commit Event candidate (held as not_direct_commit_candidate_non_default_branch, spec_hold_status='UNCONFIRMED').
Referenced Issue/ticket attaches strictly as CONTEXT_ONLY metadata on the merged PR Event, never spawns a standalone Event, and is rejected with CANNOT_LINK if targeted for manual merge.

matrix.scenario_area: Issue/ticket link never triggers automatic merge
matrix.observable_outcome: Two merged PRs referencing the same CONTEXT_ONLY ticket remain 2 separate standalone merged-PR Events (total_countable_events=2, total_user_composite_events=0).

matrix.scenario_area: Distinction between prohibited auto multi-PR merge and user manual merge
matrix.observable_outcome: Without a user manual_merge command, multi-PR inputs stay separate (EV-006); only an explicit same-repository user manual_merge creates 1 USER_COMPOSITE with merge_origin='USER_MANUAL_MERGE' (EV-009).
Initial ingestion preserves 1 merged-PR Event without ungrounded auto-split (EV-007); explicit user split partitions commits into 2 active split-child Events without double counting (EV-008).

User split supersedes parent Event (searchable_as_top_level=false, counted_in_metrics=false, version=2) and creates 2 active split-child Events (total_countable_events=2; wire command/status tokens UNCONFIRMED).

matrix.scenario_area: User manual merge (same-repository only -> single USER_COMPOSITE)
matrix.observable_outcome: Same-repository manual merge creates 1 active USER_COMPOSITE (merge_origin='USER_MANUAL_MERGE') and subsumes both member Events (EV-009: total_countable_events=1, total_user_composite_events=1); cross-repository manual merge even within the same workspace is rejected with zero mutation (EV-016).

Subsumed USER_COMPOSITE members have searchable_as_top_level=false and counted_in_metrics=false (EV-010); nesting a USER_COMPOSITE root or subsumed member is strictly forbidden (EV-014); dissolving restores members without double counting (EV-012).

User exclude transitions target Event to logical_state='excluded' (spec_lifecycle_status='UNCONFIRMED', version=2), removes it from active search/metrics while keeping sibling Events active and source provenance intact.

matrix.scenario_area: User dissolve curation command (restores members + marks dependent Claims stale)
matrix.observable_outcome: User dissolve marks USER_COMPOSITE dissolved (not searchable/counted), restores member Events to standalone active (total_countable_events: 1 -> 2), and emits claim_side_effects marking dependent Claim clm_syn_012_1 as expected_effect='STALE' (spec_claim_status='UNCONFIRMED').
Manual merge targeting a CONTEXT_ONLY ticket or UNKNOWN-held commit returns REJECTED with CANNOT_LINK and state_mutated=false.

matrix.scenario_area: CANNOT_LINK rejection (forbidden USER_COMPOSITE nesting / excluded target)
matrix.observable_outcome: Manual merge targeting an already-subsumed USER_COMPOSITE member, an existing USER_COMPOSITE root, or an excluded Event returns REJECTED with CANNOT_LINK and state_mutated=false.
Command with stale expected_version=1 against current version=2 returns REJECTED (rejection_category='version_conflict', spec_error_code='UNCONFIRMED') and state_mutated=false.
Cross-workspace manual merge, foreign-workspace exclude, and same-workspace cross-repository manual merge return REJECTED (spec_error_code='UNCONFIRMED') with state_mutated=false.
Explicitly tagged POST_MVP (B-003); post-INITIAL_BACKFILL PR observation is recorded as deferred_post_mvp (spec_hold_status='UNCONFIRMED') rather than auto-ingested in MVP.
Explicitly tagged POST_MVP (B-003); UNKNOWN commit remains held in MVP (never interpreted as NO_MATCH_OBSERVED) and late PR recovery transition is deferred to B-003.
